name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: More Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool charges dropped by Pirro's office
changes.summary: Since Friday, D.C. U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro's office has dropped charges against three more people accused of vandalism.

changes.title: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" continues Hollywood's hot streak at the box office
changes.summary: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" leapt straight to the top of the box office this weekend. Its $360 million opening weekend debut is the biggest in U.S. history. Marlow Stern, chief correspondent at Variety, joins CBS News to discuss all the latest movie news.

changes.title: U.S. Sends Flight With Deportees to Venezuela for First Time Since Earthquakes
changes.summary: A plane with 147 Venezuelans landed on Monday in the South American country amid criticism over the deaths of deportees housed in a collapsed building during June’s quakes.

changes.title: Trump says Jeanine Pirro "choked" in dropping Reflecting Pool cases
changes.summary: "She folded like an umbrella," President Trump said of Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia.

changes.title: A Currency Trader at Heart, Bessent Bets on Japan’s Yen
changes.summary: Coordinated intervention allowed Japan to support its currency without selling off its U.S. debt holdings.

changes.title: Pirro Meets With Trump at the White House After He Said She ‘Choked’ in Reflecting Pool Case
changes.summary: President Trump said Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for Washington, D.C., “folded like an umbrella.” For now, her job appeared to be safe, according to two people familiar with the meeting.

changes.title: Inside the Democratic Socialists of America Summit
changes.summary: Our politics reporter Kellen Browning went to the Democratic Socialists of America’s national summit in Chicago to learn more about the group’s new platform.

changes.title: These 25 U.S. States Are Suing the Trump Administration. Here's Why
changes.summary: President Donald Trump speaks to the media in the Oval Office of the White House in Washington, D.C. on Aug. 3, 2026. —Chip Somodevilla––Getty Images A coalition of 25 U.S. states is suing the Trump Administration , arguing the President’s latest round of sweeping tariffs on over 80 countries exceed his legal authority.

changes.title: The New Rush to Mine America
changes.summary: More expansive than the island of Manhattan, Thacker Pass in northern Nevada is the biggest U.S. lithium-mining project developed in decades. changes.title: US Northwest battles wildfires after Spokane neighborhoods scorched
changes.summary: Wildfires supercharged by drought and intense heat tore through the northwestern U.S. city of Spokane, forcing the evacuation of 65,000 people and reducing hundreds of buildings to cinders as firefighters raced Monday to contain the flames.
